adjustments.reason: H-2 (external audit, pre-REL-004 fix): `http_date_to_unix` parsed the year as `i64` with NO range check (day/hour/minute/second all had one). With an absurd year the `era * 146_097` term in `days_from_civil` overflowed i64 — reproduced in-repo: `year = i64::MAX` → panic `attempt to multiply with overflow` at retry.rs:172 (debug), wrap-around in release. Fix: a 4-digit year bound (`1000..=9999`, per RFC 9110's `year = 4DIGIT`) returning `None`, plus saturating arithmetic as defence-in-depth. The bounded range is deliberate: silently degrading a malformed date to 0 would assert `retry immediately` — the same class of fabricated semantics as ERR-003. +82 wc -l measured standalone; this entry is the H-2 step of a two-step chain on this file (H-1 follows).
adjustments.authorized_by: Owner 2026-09-11 order「不留负债，走 A——先修完再发」(audit item H-2) — ledger adjustment per §11.1.4

adjustments.reason: H-1 (external audit, pre-REL-004 fix): `RetryProvider` is a `Provider` decorator, and `LmrsClient::with_retry()` wraps EVERY registered provider with it — but the decorator did not forward `capabilities()` / `protocol_name()` / `last_retry_after()`. Two measured consequences: (a) capability adjudication (CAP-003) received the DEFAULT declaration (`declared == false`), so a provider that explicitly declares a face `unsupported` was reclassified as `undeclared` and merely warned about instead of rejected — end-to-end, Ollama + `tools` returned `Unsupported` bare but was DISPATCHED TO THE NETWORK once `with_retry()` was on, i.e. the CAP-003 fix silently regressed; (b) `last_retry_after()` returned `None` through the decorator, breaking the ERR-004 hint chain for nested wrapping. Fix: forward all three. +105 wc -l measured ON THE POST-MERGE TREE (H-1 alone measured +104; the second step of the chain is recorded against the merged baseline).
